items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: Timme Rosenkrantz and Mezz Mezzrow, and those guys were frequent visitors in the United States.

ctx.x: Oh sure, Leonard was over here, because one of the very first articles that appeared on -- my contribution to the business was through the Melody Maker.

Because in those days, Leonard Feather and Timme Rosenkrantz and Mezz Mezzrow, and those guys were frequent visitors in the United States. And a lot of them will be here for an extended length of time.
Every thing is covered -- you know, the scene is covered thoroughly all over.
